description: This file contains abstract base test class for custom Grain Directory implementations in Orleans, using xUnit for testing. It defines tests for registration, lookup, overwrite, and unregister operations on grain addresses.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryTests
classes.description: An abstract base class for testing custom implementations of IGrainDirectory, providing shared test methods for registration, lookup, and unregister operations.

methods.name: RegisterLookupUnregisterLookup
methods.description: Tests registering a grain address, looking it up, and unregistering it, then verifying the address is no longer accessible.

methods.name: DoNotOverwriteEntry
methods.description: Ensures that registering with a different activation or silo does not overwrite an existing address.

methods.name: OverwriteEntryIfMatch
methods.description: Tests that registration can overwrite an existing address if the previous address matches, and prevents overwrite otherwise.

methods.name: DoNotDeleteDifferentActivationIdEntry
methods.description: Verifies that unregistering an address with a different activation id does not delete the original entry.

methods.name: LookupNotFound
methods.description: Checks that looking up a non-existent grain id returns null.
